name: Hananiah
overview: Hananiah was a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of Shelemiah, as recorded in Jeremiah 37:13. There is no information regarding his tribal affiliation or additional notes about his life or role in Scripture. His identity is grounded in this familial connection within the context of the prophetic book of Jeremiah.
namesAndTitles: The name Hananiah means 'YHWH is gracious,' reflecting a theologically rich Hebrew name. This proper name, not given directly by God, appears in Jeremiah 37:13 and conveys a recognition of God's grace.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Hananiah as the father of Shelemiah, as indicated in Jeremiah 37:13. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Hananiah's significance in the biblical narrative stems from his role as the father of Shelemiah, who appears in the context of Jeremiah's prophetic ministry. Although Hananiah himself is not a prominent actor in the narrative, his mention situates Shelemiah within a familial and historical framework important for understanding the people involved during Jeremiah's time.
